title: Knapsack of the Ancient Vault
statement:
An explorer discovers an ancient vault containing N priceless relics. Each relic has a monetary value V_i and a weight W_i. The explorer carries a knapsack that can hold a maximum total weight of C.

Determine the maximum total monetary value the explorer can carry away without exceeding the knapsack's weight capacity. Each relic can either be taken completely or left behind (0/1 choice).
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and C (number of relics, max weight capacity).
Second line: N space-separated integers representing the values of relics.
Third line: N space-separated integers representing the weights of relics.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: the maximum value obtainable.

sampleCases.explanation: Select items with weight 3 and 4 (values 4 + 5 = 9, weight 7 <= 7).
